historical_record.description: Second Christian Science Church, designed by William H. Crim.

The church of the Second Church of Christ, Scientist was built here in 1917 to the design of William H. Crim Jr.: two and a half storeys of unreinforced masonry, almost nine thousand square feet. A 1993 survey gave it National Register status code 3S — eligible as an individual property — but it fell under the city's 1992 unreinforced masonry ordinance and the congregation applied to demolish it.
